body.name: muH
body.def: Order each unfinished task by \(r(\tau)=(|R_\tau|,c_\tau)\), where \(c_\tau\) is its finite within-mask gate, fixing-suffix, and case-phase count. Enumerate the finitely many input-possible ranks as \(r_0<\cdots<r_{M_H}\) and set \(\mu_H(\zeta)=(n_{M_H},\ldots,n_0)\), where \(n_j\) counts tasks of rank \(r_j\). Reverse rank-count lexicographic order realizes the finite multiset extension: replacing a task by finitely many strictly lower-rank children decreases \(\mu_H\).
